review.purpose: Separate public price-index levels from twelve-month inflation and test display rebasing.
review.finding: A successful official unregistered request supplies two series over2019–2024, retained as a derived144-row recording rather than HTTP bytes; complete calendar and same-month prior-year join preserve gaps. Exact source/rate fingerprints distinguish a pure rebasing experiment from revisions; replay reproduces the successful live retained rows and numeric values exactly; rebasing changes levels, not proportional rates.

review.purpose: Join survey capabilities without converting omitted flags to false.
review.finding: Three synthetic surveys contextualize five popular candidates. One candidate has unknown annual-average support; it is retained as NULL and not used as an unrelated monthly-selection condition. Entirely synthetic evidence, not live BLS catalog validation.

review.purpose: Use a candidate list while checking measurement contracts independently.
review.finding: Five synthetic popular IDs have neither rank scores nor enough dimensions to establish comparability. Metadata reduces them to two; the list is explicitly nonexhaustive and not an official popularity claim.
